notes.title: Masterplan Tycoon | MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
Dear Builders,

We're excited to announce a significant update! To start, [b]Masterplan Tycoon[/b] has been in release for over a year, during which we've released 6 updates, all thanks to your active engagement and feedback. Shall we delve into what's included in this latest update?

[h1][b]➤ New Campaign![/b][/h1]
We're going to experience the atmosphere of the gold rush. A bit harsher conditions and a bit less sun, rum, and carefreeness. Let's try to mine some gold and survive in this tough world. The campaign will be available for existing saves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40649282/fe9fedb73ec8400909248d5f7af934b50e004c1e.gif[/img]

[h1][b]➤ Random Generation![/b][/h1]
Now we'll have an infinite number of maps to play through. If before you could rely on my support on classic maps, now it's every man for himself!

[h1][b]➤ Trains![/b][/h1]
This is a new type of links. More complex conditions require more sophisticated solutions. Now you have another way to connect nodes, and you can show more creativity in organizing your chains. By the way, rails can be laid over resource zones, making all areas of the map more accessible. But unfortunately, they cannot intersect. Engineers messed something up, but what can you do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40649282/e7ca706a2da4af2a6555f14bb03421224df002a3.gif[/img]

[h1][b]➤ Efficiency![/b][/h1]
This is a feature I wanted to see when the game was released, but a year ago, we couldn't implement it. Now nodes involved in resource extraction have an additional parameter - efficiency. Place farms and fields more skillfully so they work faster. By the way, if it seems like the game has slowed down - don't worry. We've increased the base production speed of such nodes, so everyone will find their own play style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40649282/e346366c5e7b0dda6e7e7ca139ca20dbb72ce4c9.gif[/img]

[h1][b]➤ Fixed / Updated / Added / Reworked / Optimized[/b][/h1]
Added: New Mountain Campaign
Added: New nodes & resources
Added: Procedural map generation
Added: Efficiency node radius
Added: Train links

In addition, there are over 300 changes, fixes, and improvements. The most significant ones include:

Reworked: Improved mechanism for saving migration
Reworked: Enhanced bounds check for camera location
Reworked: Forest planting now enabled by default
Optimization: Started checking overlap efficiency with minimum link length threshold
Optimization: Tiles now only cut on current location resource zones
Optimization: Small cleanup on the map generated to improve performance
Optimization: Reduction in map-file size
Fixed: Chinese, French, Polish, Russian localizations
Fixed: Disabled camera zoom ability while input is blocked
Fixed: Color-blind terms in research window after research completion
Fixed: Flow issues with Storage <- Pillar <- Node, Storage -> Pillar -> Node, and Storage-Pillar-Pillar-Node
Fixed: Destruction of link with locked node state connected
Fixed: Previous location target on back button click after save load
Fixed: Incorrect caching of localization Manager in UIBuildMenuChainButton
Fixed: Checked links for overlaps at incomplete times
Fixed: Renamed CannedSoup to Soup and Wear to Stuff
Fixed: Removed unused demo end video and related materials

[hr][/hr]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1644500/Masterplan_Tycoon/

[h2][b] ABOUT MASTERPLAN TYCOON [/b][/h2]
[b]Masterplan Tycoon[/b] is the game where your creativity and logistics skills are put to the test! In this minimalistic simulation, you will build interconnected chains of products and open new missions by completing various tasks to create the biggest system you can.

Join our Discord server:
[url=https://discord.gg/JDXWssYNA3]Discord[/url]

notes.title: 1-YEAR ANNIVERSARY!
notes.content:
Hello Builders, it's Anton, your fellow dev!
 
Today marks a special date for me and [b]Masterplan Tycoon[/b]. Exactly a year ago, my first independent game was released. This moment has been long-awaited - over 10 years of developing both gaming and non-gaming software led me to this point. [b]Masterplan Tycoon[/b] gave me the opportunity to bring my ideas to life in games, and it wouldn't have happened without you - our community. I can't put into words how I feel when such a large number of people play your game. Each new perspective makes [b]Masterplan Tycoon[/b] more multifaceted than I could have imagined - it's amazing! Thank you all so much for this!

To celebrate this milestone, we've prepared a major update. It will include many cool innovations, and now I'll tell you exactly what:

[h1][b]➤ New Campaign![/b][/h1]
We're going to experience the atmosphere of the gold rush. A bit harsher conditions and a bit less sun, rum, and carefreeness. Let's try to mine some gold and survive in this tough world. The campaign will be available for existing saves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40649282/fe9fedb73ec8400909248d5f7af934b50e004c1e.gif[/img]

[h1][b]➤ Random Generation![/b][/h1]
Now we'll have an infinite number of maps to play through. If before you could rely on my support on classic maps, now it's every man for himself!

[h1][b]➤ Trains![/b][/h1]
This is a new type of links. More complex conditions require more sophisticated solutions. Now you have another way to connect nodes, and you can show more creativity in organizing your chains. By the way, rails can be laid over resource zones, making all areas of the map more accessible. But unfortunately, they cannot intersect. Engineers messed something up, but what can you do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40649282/adcf614ce717337df374678f237dba60812cc1b5.gif[/img]

[h1][b]➤ Efficiency![/b][/h1]
This is a feature I wanted to see when the game was released, but a year ago, we couldn't implement it. Now nodes involved in resource extraction have an additional parameter - efficiency. Place farms and fields more skillfully so they work faster. By the way, if it seems like the game has slowed down - don't worry. We've increased the base production speed of such nodes, so everyone will find their own play style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40649282/06eadcccc194ac870bc891ecd9e6e4a00f992bf5.gif[/img]

In addition, a huge number of various fixes have been made, and a few more bugs that I couldn't find, but for some reason, players do. I can't figure out why this happens...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40649282/40552f0076e9480e8bc44f45ec818fa91a28a19c.png[/img]

Once again, a huge thank you to everyone for this fantastic year! I hope we'll make and play many more games together!

Anton.

[h2][b]Get it NOW![/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1644500/Masterplan_Tycoon

[h2][b]OR[/b][/h2]

Participate in the giveaway hosted by Ravenage Games  on Twitter - https://twitter.com/Ravenage_Games/status/1766480562397577335, where you have the chance to win 1 of 5 game keys - hurry up!

notes.title: Post-Release Update #1
notes.content:
Dear builders,

Today, we are pleased to announce the release of our first update that addresses many of the issues and concerns that have been raised by the community. This patch includes various fixes, reworks, and additions that will make your gaming experience even more enjoyable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40649282/950163c642356dbb075ebe4d50fa5d347d3e048c.png[/img]

We have listened to your feedback and made several improvements to the gameplay mechanics, fixed bugs, and reworked some parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40649282/ee6ec9c3309f3e9bd21189e5d4a324905b79717f.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]

[b][h3]🔴 Added[/h3][/b][list]
[*] Nodes can be built upon renovation resources tiles (fields, forest, etc.)
[*] Multiple build nodes over left-ctrl
[*] Setting to disable water animation
[*] Simple save backups
[/list]
[b][h3]🟡 Fixed[/h3][/b][list]
[*] The build menu won't open again upon pressing RMB with the build menu already open
[*] Remove all maintenance from steam buildings except the steam engine. Almost increase all steam buildings out 1 -> 2
[*] Fixed Reconnect link exception in some cases[/list]
[b][h3]🟢 Reworked[/h3][/b][list]
[*] Reduced missions transfer time 15 -> 10
[/list]
Once again, we want to thank everyone who has been a part of this journey. This game wouldn't be possible without your support and encouragement.

We are also thrilled to say that this is just the beginning. More exciting updates and content are in the works right now, and we can't wait to share them with you all.
